<thought>Using the molecular formula C₁₈H₁₄O₂ and the DBE of 12, the molecule can be built from an acetyl‑ester fragment (C₂H₃O₂) and an aromatic fragment that contains a phenyl ring attached to a naphthyl ring (C₁₆H₁₁). When the –O– of the ester is linked to the aromatic carbon, the combined formula matches C₁₈H₁₄O₂. The neutral SMILES for the two fragments are:

1. Acetyl‑ester fragment: CC(=O)O  
2. Aromatic fragment with a phenyl‑naphthyl skeleton: c1ccc(-c2ccc3ccccc3c2)cc1

These two fragments can be joined to give the full structure of the sample.
